contentItem.title: 由中项线段生成无穷多类无理线段
contentItem.englishTitle: From a medial straight line there arise irrational straight lines infinite in number, and none of them is the same as any of the preceding.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: From a medial straight line there arise irrational straight lines infinite in number, and none of them is the same as any of the preceding.
从中项无理线段起, 出现了无理线段个无限的数量, 没有一个与前面任何一个相同。
Let A be a medial straight line; I say that from A there arise irrational straight lines infinite in number, and none of them is the same as any of the preceding.
让我们把A变成中项无理线段;我说,从A起,就出现了无理线段个无限的数字,没有一个与前面任何一个数字相同。

Let a rational straight line B be set out, and let the square on C be equal to the rectangle B, A; therefore C is irrational; [[X. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-10-def-4)] for that which is contained by an irrational and a rational straight line is irrational. [deduction from [X. 20](/principles/euclid-10-20)]
列出有理线段 B,C的正方形等于矩形 B,A;因此,C等于无理;无理的构成者为无理,有理线段等于无理  [deduction from [[X. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-10-def-4)] [X. 20](/principles/euclid-10-20)
And it is not the same with any of the preceding; for the square on none of the preceding, if applied to a rational straight line produces as breadth a medial straight line.
与前一种情况不同,对于前一种情况,正方形的试验如果适用于有理线段的试验,则产生宽度为中项无理线段的产量。
Again, let the square on D be equal to the rectangle B, C; therefore the square on D is irrational. [deduction from [X. 20](/principles/euclid-10-20)]
D正方形等于矩形、BC,因此D正方形无理 [deduction from [X. 20](/principles/euclid-10-20)

Therefore D is irrational; [[X. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-10-def-4)] and it is not the same with any of the preceding, for the square on none of the preceding, if applied to a rational straight line, produces C as breadth.
因此,D是无理;与前一情况不同,因为正方形与前一情况无关,如果适用于有理线段,则产生C宽度。 [[X. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-10-def-4)]

Similarly, if this arrangement proceeds ad infinitum, it is manifest that from the medial straight line there arise irrational straight lines infinite in number, and none is the same with any of the preceding. Q. E. D.
同样,如果这种安排无限期地进行,那么从中项无理线段起显然会产生无理线段个无限的数目,而与前一种情况一样。
